decisions.summary: Check brief: every finding of one report applied in one message, record commands and tests once
research/CLAUDE.md trimmed to rules (11,100 chars); full text moved verbatim to docs/research-record-rules.md; plan claims 'No rule is dropped'
decisions.why: R3 rec 4, adopted by the GM, is to trim the file TO its operative rules and move rationale and history out. The built file drops operative rules, not only rationale, so the plan's 'keeps every rule' is false on a section-by-section comparison against 37c20e57's file: (259) the assembled assets/glossary.json and research/assets/glossary.js are written by make glossary and never hand-edited; (190) never link a URL nobody fetched, the registry searched by percent-decoded URL, a 'Pointers, not read' item with no entry stays plain while a REGISTERED name is linked whatever label surrounds it; (194) a roster key with nothing to quote leaves the roster, a translation note names its translator, a source's own English needs no note; (195) the absence note's registry entry stays, marked Not cited; a 'settled' note re-opens on anything that changes what can be read; a GM-downloaded copy is read by the session, the footnote links the PUBLIC page and says the copy was read, quote-check runs against the copy; a paywalled text with a public abstract is cited for the abstract's words only; a GROUNDS note may name several reasons, and using one of the four unexemplified reasons on an existing note takes a written argument at that note's page; (209) a glossary definition is written from the record's own text; record-format and quote-check stay two agents dispatched in the same turn (spec 209 D5); (211) assertions resting on a NOT-APPLICABLE source keep their label until the GM rules; (229) a spec paragraph's pixel figure goes in a comment beside it, the paragraph is retired when a generator encodes the rule with its reasoning, and a why the code lacked goes on the page with the comment pointing at the anchor. Nothing makes keeping these impossible or defeats the rec's purpose: they are a few hundred characters against a 32,000-character cut. Restore each to its section of research/CLAUDE.md (compactly), or record it as rationale with a reason, and re-measure the claim. Aside, not a finding: the rec named docs/research-doctrine.md as the home for the rationale; a new docs/research-record-rules.md narrows nothing.

decisions.summary: Raster-mode lit-paddy/beads browser check waits for its state with the driver's bounded settles (2 s), assertions unchanged; T39 three runs green
decisions.why: Fixed, not hidden: no skip, xfail, retry or loosened expectation; the asserted tuples are unchanged and a value that never arrives within the bound still fails. A stale read equal to the wanted value could pass, but the original same-tick read passed on the same stale value, so it is no weaker than before.
